resources.string: Trakt needs an application of your own. Sign in at trakt.tv, open trakt.tv/oauth/applications, choose New Application, enter any name and, as the redirect address, exactly the address shown below. Save it, then enter its client id and client secret here and tap Sign in with browser. You log in and approve on trakt.tv itself; Telos never sees your Trakt password.
Redirect address for your Trakt application
